title: Tenma Tsukasa — Man Of Festivity〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome home, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Saki, you're home.
How did things go afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We took a bunch of pics to celebrate, practiced a little and went home after that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Sounds like you had a fun New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. You guys definitely had way more fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I knew that you'd be performing, but I really wasn't expecting to run into you the way we did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, you guys ran off saying that you had to get to your next location. Where'd you guys go after doing that show at the beach?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A mountain! After that, we went to a ski resort and the mall!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It ended up being a wonderful experience since we ran into so many familiar faces along the way. We also learned quite a bit as we did each show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's a ton of traveling...!
You must be exhausted!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And starving since you had to move around so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I had a few bites here and there along the way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. But you could use a real meal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That'd be nice.
Unfortunately, I'll just have to wait since we won't be having dinner for some time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You worked really hard today, Tsukasa, so you should have something to eat if you're that hungry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom! Tsukasa's hungry!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, the New Year's food won't be ready for a while... Would you like some mochi in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom, I want some too!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Sure, dear. How many would you both like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How many? I'd like...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, stop!
Tsukasa, lemme guess how many you want!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Then, I'll guess how many you'd like to have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, on three♪
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
One!
Three!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
One! You got it!
Nice guess, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. We do still have dinner to think about.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You also guessed how many I wanted correctly. I suppose I should expect no less from my little sister.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I also had a feeling that you didn't want to be too full.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: In that case, I have another question for you two. How would you like to have them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sweet soybean powder, right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And you want it with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. Can you read my mind, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm... Hm!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I got it!
Two wrapped in seaweed and one with sweet soybean powder!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's correct!
Well done, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heehee! I know everything there is to know about you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, would you like to try reading my mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! You need us to set the table!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! She needs us to get the seaweed and soybean powder ready!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
You're both correct.
I know you're tired, but I'd really appreciate it if you did those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki, I'll set up the table.
You head to the kitchen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Roger dodger!
